cases.name: Sharon Faye "Shari" Smith
cases.narrative: On 6/6/1985, her body was found behind an old Masonic Lodge in Saluda County, SC. He had abducted her at gunpoint from the end of her driveway on Platt Springs Road in Lexington, SC while she was collecting mail from the mailbox. Authorities were unable to determine her cause of death, but a residue of duct tape on Shari’s face suggested she had died of suffocation by having had duct tape wrapped around her face.
